title: Round 2 of the diagnostic audition, after round 1 is scored: stability for the cheer, the ceremony and a lesson line; two audio tags; the friends' other two voices; and the editor's H1 A/B (six lines, three text forms each, Nitzi and hero-son).
note: Written by the voice-and-sound-director on 2026-10-29. The model is eleven_v4, the expected winner of round 1. If round 1 picks eleven_v4_turbo, the director changes defaults.model (and the S1 text, if the full stop won) before this round; the plan prints the model of every clip. Settings are stability 0.5, similarity 0.75, speaker boost unless a clip says otherwise; the H1 clips stay at 0.5 so that only the text changes.
